articles.summary:

In affected configurations, client upload access does not consistently align with the associated collection’s access configuration.

You are affected if:
- You use client uploads with `@payloadcms/storage-vercel-blob`.
- Authenticated users can access the client-upload route.

Applications that do not enable client uploads are not affected.

articles.title: USN-9000-1: Twisted vulnerability
articles.summary: It was discovered that Twisted's IMAP server mishandled wildcard patterns in mailbox list commands. An authenticated remote attacker could possibly use this issue to cause Twisted to use excessive resources, leading to a denial of service.

articles.title: GHSA: odf-kit: HTML injection leading to XSS in odtToHtml() and odsToHtml() via unescaped style attribute values
articles.summary:
### Summary

ODF style attribute values are interpolated into `style="..."` attributes without HTML-escaping in **both** of odf-kit's to-HTML renderers (`odtToHtml` and `odsToHtml`). A double-quote character inside an attacker-controlled style value breaks out of the attribute, allowing arbitrary HTML/attribute injection — and therefore script execution (XSS) — from a crafted `.odt` or `.ods` file

articles.title: USN-8997-1: Net-SNMP vulnerability
articles.summary: It was discovered that Net-SNMP incorrectly handled newly accepted connections in the SMUX module. An unauthenticated remote attacker could possibly use this issue to cause Net-SNMP to block indefinitely, resulting in a denial of service.

articles.title: USN-8996-1: APT vulnerability
articles.summary: Max Justicz discovered that APT incorrectly handled hard links when encountering redirects and retrying package downloads. A remote on-path attacker could possibly use this issue to trick APT into installing an unverified package and achieve remote code execution with root privileges.

articles.title: CVE-2026-120644 — CVSS 9.1
articles.summary:
CGI::Cookie versions before 5.00 for Perl allow cookie attribute injection via unvalidated path, domain and expires values.

The path, domain and expires values are written into the Set-Cookie header without checking for semicolons or control characters.

An application that sets them from request data can be made to add other cookie attributes, such as Domain or SameSite.

articles.title: CVE-2026-120641 — CVSS 8.8
articles.summary:
CGI versions before 5.00 for Perl return upload filenames with any client-supplied path, including ../ and Windows paths.

The name returned for an uploaded file is the filename parameter of the part's Content-Disposition header, unchanged.

An application that saves the upload under this name can be made to write outside the intended directory.

articles.title: CVE-2026-120637 — CVSS 9.8
articles.summary:
CGI versions before 5.00 for Perl take request parameters from the process command line arguments for an unrecognised REQUEST_METHOD.

For a REQUEST_METHOD such as OPTIONS, CGI falls through to its offline debugging mode, which is on by default, and builds the parameters and path_info from the process's command line arguments.

articles.title: CVE-2026-121736 — CVSS 5.3
articles.summary: NocoDB 0.300.0 before 2026.08.0 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in the POST /api/v2/oauth/authorize handler that allows unauthenticated attackers to create OAuth authorization codes. Attackers can send anonymous requests with client_id, redirect_uri and approved=true to insert unbounded ownerless authorization code records, limited only by rate limiting.

articles.title: CVE-2026-121733 — CVSS 5.4
articles.summary: Bagisto before 2.4.5 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated customers to upload HTML files via the RMA send-message endpoint without type or extension validation. Attackers can upload a .html attachment containing JavaScript served under /storage/rma-conversation/, executing script in the shop's origin when an administrator opens it.

articles.title: CVE-2026-121731 — CVSS 8.8
articles.summary: RosarioSIS before 12.9 contains a sql injection vulnerability that allows authenticated non-student users, including parents, to inject SQL via the unquoted period_id parameter in StudentSummary.php. Attackers can supply payloads without single quotes into IN() clauses to extract administrator password hashes and student records through time-based queries or modify data via stacked statements.

articles.title: CVE-2026-121729 — CVSS 8.3
articles.summary: emailflare before commit cf31f33 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the inbox service /api/keys routes that allows any authenticated member to list, create and revoke API keys. Attackers can mint a global live API key accepted by /v1/send to send mail from any domain, or revoke existing keys to disable integrations.

articles.title: CVE-2026-121728 — CVSS 5.3
articles.summary: SourceHut meta.sr.ht 0.56.11 before 0.89.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to register accounts when public registration is disabled. Attackers can obtain a CSRF token from /login and POST credentials to /register/step2, which invokes the unchecked GraphQL RegisterAccount mutation to create accounts.

articles.title: CVE-2026-121727 — CVSS 7.5
articles.summary: Kore before 4.3.0 contains an integer underflow vulnerability in HTTP request body handling that allows unauthenticated attackers to bypass http_body_max by sending more body bytes than declared. Attackers can send oversized first segments over many concurrent POST, PUT or DELETE connections, wrapping content_length to grow buffers unbounded and exhaust worker memory.
